Q8537.reason: Whether punishment is justified depends on which concept of punishment is adopted, so the definition must be separated from the justification to avoid building a conclusion into the definition.

Q6097.reason: Modern statutes convert the fee tail to a fee simple in the cousin, and the grantor had already conveyed his entire interest, so the niece takes nothing.

Q8324.reason: Agitation with craving and fear of withdrawal suggests a low-dopamine state, and decreased synaptic dopamine is the closest option; none of the choices describes a hyperdopaminergic state.
